title: Age-friendly Action Plan
body:
Age-friendly Action Plan
The City of Waterloo is developing its next
Age-friendly Action Plan (2027–2030)
, and we want to hear from you. Together, we can better understand the needs of older adults in our community by identifying gaps in service, challenges in accessing support, opportunities for improvement, and what is already working well.
Your input will help shape recommendations for the Action Plan and guide decisions about future programs, services and funding. By sharing your experiences and ideas, you’ll be helping us build a more welcoming, supportive, and age-friendly Waterloo.
Stay informed
Subscribe for updates, news and information about this project by clicking +Follow in the banner.
